01 / Personalised pursuit

Advertising agents

One eye. A crown. Absolutely no boundaries. These hooded agents patrol straight corridors, offering cookies and terrible deals.

No fighting back: wait for an opening and slip behind them. The correct path might be right under their watchful eye.

02 / Roguelike gameplay

Open. Hope. Regret.

A brighter torch, an extra heart, Adblock or five seconds with the full map. Every chest could turn the run around.

Sometimes literally: rotated maps, curses, a dimmed torch or a freshly rebuilt maze. Death resets your temporary effects. Your memory is yours to keep.

03 / Three biomes · More to come

New scenery. Same ads.

From the stone corridors of Undercrypt to the tangled Tracking Woods and narrow alleys of Sponsored City.

Nine campaign floors across three regions, each with its own look and soundtrack. Apparently, advertising has excellent coverage.

Survival guide, abridged

Your memory is the upgrade.

01

Learn the way out

Procedural mazes, misleading branches and landmarks. Death sends you back to the floor's start. What you remember stays with you.

02

Don't click everything

Download buttons are traps. Hooded advertising agents patrol the corridors. No combat: wait, dodge, and find a way around.

03

Open at your own risk

A chest might hold a brighter torch, Adblock, a heart or a glimpse of the map. It might also rearrange your plans.

04

Leave a little evidence

Double-tap to drop a breadcrumb. Ten per floor. Bloodstains mark the lessons you learned the expensive way.

The escape

Campaign

Nine floors. Three regions. One final close button. We believe in you. Technically.

Endless
